publishing._mode_note: Owner's standing instruction (night of 25 Nov 2026): choose the best option without asking, make the videos and publish them. Only a video that passed QC with every number verified is uploaded, as public; the daily run then reports to the owner.

_require_real_footage_note: Owner's decision (night of 25 Nov 2026, replaces the morning rule): real or AI-generated footage is used only when a connected app gives it free and without a watermark; otherwise the pipeline's own drawn graphics are the standard. Never use a tool that adds a watermark, never spend money or paid credits.
